question: List the names of all product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories

question: Show the email address of every customer.
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customers

question: List every product's name and price.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products

question: Which countries do our customers come from? List each country once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers

question: List all the distinct order statuses.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders

question: Which customers are from the US? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'US'

question: List the names of products priced above 100.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 100

question: Show the order IDs of all delivered orders.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: Which products have fewer than 100 units in stock? Show the product names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE stock_qty < 100

question: List the names of products priced between 40 and 100 (inclusive).
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 40 AND 100

question: What is the email address of the customer named Bob Jones?
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE first_name = 'Bob' AND last_name = 'Jones'

question: Which orders have a total amount greater than 200? Show the order ID and total amount.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 200

question: List the order IDs of all orders that are not cancelled.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: What is the average product price?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: What is the total amount of all delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: What is the price of the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM products

question: How many units of stock do we have in total across all products?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(stock_qty) FROM products

question: How many orders are pending?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

question: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

question: How many orders are there for each status? Show the status and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: How many customers are there in each country? Show the country and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: Which countries have more than one customer? Show the country and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Which customers have placed more than one order? Show the customer ID and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Show each customer ID and their total order amount, only for customers whose orders total more than 300.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(total_amount) > 300

question: For each product ID, show the total quantity sold, only for products with at least 2 units sold.
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(quantity) >= 2

question: List each product's name together with its category name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.name AS category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

question: Show the order ID and the customer's email for every order.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.email FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

question: How many products are in each category? Show the category name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: What is the average product price in each category? Show the category name and average price.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(p.price) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Show the first names of customers who have a cancelled order.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

question: List the names of the products in the Electronics category.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics'

question: What is the total amount of all orders placed by customers from the US?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'US'

question: List the IDs of the orders placed by Alice Smith.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.first_name = 'Alice' AND c.last_name = 'Smith'

question: For each order, show the order ID and the number of line items in it.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.item_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id

question: Which distinct products has Alice Smith bought? Show the product names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE c.first_name = 'Alice' AND c.last_name = 'Smith'

question: What is the revenue per category, computed as the sum of quantity times unit price over order items? Show the category name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Which customers have bought products from the Books category? Show their email addresses (each once).
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.email FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books'

question: For each customer, how many distinct products have they purchased? Show the customer's first name, last name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name

question: Which customers bought the 'Laptop Pro 14'? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Laptop Pro 14'

question: What is the total quantity sold per category for delivered orders only? Show the category name and total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.name

question: What are the 3 most expensive products? Show the name and price, most expensive first.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all products sorted by price from cheapest to most expensive, showing the name and price.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC

question: Which customer has spent the most in total across all their orders? Show their first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the top 3 customers by total order amount, with their email and total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.email ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which product has the largest stock quantity? Show its name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY stock_qty DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of the 5 cheapest products, cheapest first.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 5

question: Show the 2 largest orders by total amount: the order ID and total amount, largest first.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 2

question: How many orders were placed in the last 30 days?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

question: How many orders were placed in the last 7 days?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

question: How many customers signed up this calendar year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)

question: For each year, how many orders were placed? Show the year as a number and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS year, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)

question: What is the total amount of delivered orders placed in the last 90 days?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

question: Show the emails of customers who signed up in the last 365 days.
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '365 days'

question: Which products are priced above the average product price? Show the name and price.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)

question: Which orders have a total amount above the average order total? Show the order ID and total amount.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders)

question: Which other products are in the same category as 'Running Shoes'? Show their names, excluding Running Shoes itself.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE name = 'Running Shoes') AND name <> 'Running Shoes'

question: Which customers have placed an order with a total amount greater than 1000? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 1000)

question: Who placed the single largest order by total amount? Show the customer's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1)

question: What is the name of the cheapest product in the Electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' AND p.price = (SELECT MIN(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = c.category_id)
